title: Applicant Tracking Report
description: Applications, hiring funnel, sources, job board ROI and time to fill.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers Applicant Tracking. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: Applications, hiring funnel, sources, job board ROI and time to fill.

Hires rising slower than applications means a leaky funnel, not a sourcing problem.

**Ask:** which roles take longest from apply to start?
Where candidates come from and where they drop out.

The biggest step down is usually screening - often candidates who never answer.

Referrals bring fewer applicants but more hires.

**Ask:** is speed to first contact the fix?
Sponsored spend efficiency and how long positions stay open.

Compare cost per apply across boards before raising budgets.

Licensed roles (RN, BCBA, therapists) fill slowest.

**Ask:** where would a sign-on bonus pay off?
